$comment: Unverified passages (docs/research/terrain-navigation.md §11.3; RC-09, D-034 item 5): walks the mesh finds that may be
false passes. The polygons whose centroid lies in 'box' (and whose zone is 'zone', when given) are tagged in map.bin, and
a leg whose corridor crosses them carries 'unverified-passage'. The owner's in-game checks are tracked in STATUS.md:
'verified-pass' removes the tag; 'verified-block' needs a must-not-connect fixture and a mesh cut (not implemented yet).
